summary: Requested a repeat of the VerifyLeader end-to-end experiment (2fd5794c550141f7889f1530295d1294-experiment), which produced receipt 27d9e2e68fcf4e15b00b170ef9593714 and is the run that bounds that account's severity. In that receipt a leader cut from its voters while non-voters stayed reachable verified itself successfully, but no stale read was observed because the leader's lease expired before the successor committed, so the account claims a false leadership-health signal rather than a demonstrated stale read. That negative rests on a single execution of a timing-sensitive scenario, so re-running the same fixed inputs with the same comparison either confirms the bound or shows it varies. No code, inputs or measurements change; the submission is a repeat request with rationale only and validates against submission.schema.json.
